context: Sv57 is a five-level page-based 57-bit virtual-memory system in RISC-V that supports megapages, gigapages, terapages, and petapages, with a PTE format whose bits 63–54 and 9–0 match Sv39 and a translation algorithm using LEVELS 5 and PTESIZE 8.

_Figure 76. Sv57 page table entry._

The PTE format for Sv57 is shown in Figure 76. Bits 63–54 and 9–0 have the same meaning as for Sv39. Any level of PTE may be a leaf PTE, so in addition to pages, Sv57 supports _megapages_ , _gigapages_ , _terapages_ , and _petapages_ , each of which must be virtually and physically aligned to a boundary equal to its size. A page-fault exception is raised if the physical address is insufficiently aligned.

The algorithm for virtual-to-physical address translation is the same as in Section 12.3.2, except LEVELS equals 5 and PTESIZE equals 8.</target>
